from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DilutedEarningsMetric(BaseModel):
    """A specific Diluted Earnings Per Share figure extracted from a document."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The company name the filing belongs to")
    report_fiscal_year: int = Field(description="The fiscal year of the filing document (e.g., 2022)")
    data_year: int = Field(description="The specific year the EPS figure applies to (e.g., 2022, 2023)")
    metric_label: str = Field(description="The exact line-item label as written (e.g., 'Diluted Net Loss Per Common Share')")
    value: float = Field(description="The numeric EPS value; negative indicates a loss")
    currency_unit: str = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g., USD, dollars per share")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    diluted_earnings_metrics: list[DilutedEarningsMetric]
